entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2406a
entries.finding: GN-z11 in the GOODS-North field: Webb NIRCam: 0.9 to 1.5 µm blue, 2.0 to 3.4 µm green, 3.6 to 4.4 µm red. The lab reads a 120 x 120 px window of the Large JPEG, 0.29 arcsec across. The file carries no sky tags; the scale (0.002447 arcsec per pixel, to about 3%) and the direction of north (61.4° right of vertical) are the project's measurements, recorded in src/sources/esawebb-weic2406a.json.

entries.subject: Webb NIRCam science mosaics from MAST
entries.finding: Not used. The lab recipe reads a display image by URL; the archive's mosaics would need a cutout, a display transfer of our own and a hosted file, and the telescope tooling has no cutout command for survey mosaics. The galaxy is a few pixels either way.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab recipe can read a prepared local image, or the telescope tooling cuts mosaics by position.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Tacchella et al. (2023), Section 3: the extended Sérsic component, index 0.9 +/- 0.1, half-light radius 49 +/- 3 mas along the major axis, axis ratio 0.67 +/- 0.05, position angle 34 +/- 5 degrees. Used as published. The lab takes one Sérsic spheroid, so the point source is not modelled separately.

entries.subject: Flat picture bank
entries.finding: The first version drew the publisher's picture as one flat image facing the Sun (gn-z11-layers); seen from the side it was a line. Replaced by this volume.
